source_message.text:
"I got a message from someone." (Starts reading the message from the phone.)
"I keep losing all the time. I think there's something wrong with the game." -Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a!
(Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a! — message translation.)
The actor starts replying:
"Most likely, you downloaded a fake version where it's impossible to win!
Let me show you what the fake version looks like.
Let's try playing here.
The graphics look strange.
Look, we played.
We lose immediately, right?
This is the fake version.
Now let's open the real app.
Let's play a little here.
I've already placed my bet — €10, okay?
As you can see, the graphics are different here.
One more step... great.
€732.
I controlled every step myself.
Now let's withdraw the money.
We'll wait a moment, and the winning confirmation will appear here.
The money has already arrived in my account.
Look, my banking app has already sent me a notification.
And that's it.
See?
It only took a few minutes.
That's how simple it is.
That's why many people play in fake apps and end up losing their money.
Download only the official app using the link below the video and earn money just like I do."
